text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, you can't run in the Arima Kinen
just because you want to~?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a fan-voted race, after all.
Yeah, since it's a fan-voted race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is a special race among GⅠs.
You can't just enter based on past results or the desire to run alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, we need support from the fans, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A round of applause! The candidate runners for this year's Arima Kinen
are just as announced by the media!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo!
Answer the fans' passionate support
and show them a race beyond all expectations!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... everyone is placing their hopes
in Turbo's running...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, leave it to me!
The others are super strong,
but Turbo is superer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo captivated fans with her racing style
and earned their passionate support.
And now, she challenges the year-end race where demons dwell.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Race day. A massive lineup of senior-tier heavyweights
stands ready to take on Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: First up is Daitaku Helios—both a friend and a mentor.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, Helios! Turbo isn't the same slug
she used to be back when you were
teaching her, you know!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're a fine snail, after all.
Since you taught me how to run as a Front Runner,
today I'll teach you long distance!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha☆ Turbo-senpai, let's do this!
Not that I'm plannin' on losing or anything though♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fearsome opponents are numerous. Among them, the formidable rivals
who cannot be beaten on mere momentum alone are...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is such a pity that Teio-san cannot run.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if she had made it in time for the Kikuka Sho,
we might have passed on this race anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The showdown—will be next spring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family's stayer, Mejiro McQueen.
A powerhouse who conquered the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many consider him the strongest active Umamusume at middle and long distances.
And Twin Turbo is about to challenge that reigning champion.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: McQueen! Teio might not be here, but her best pal Turbo is here today!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'll teach McQueen how to run long distances too! You see, the trick is...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Do you have any idea
who you're talking to, of all people?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about her.
I'll be sure to give her a good talking-to later.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What're you doing~?
Nature, let go, let go of me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo getting dragged along by Nice Nature, who's also running in the same race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit. As for long-distance guidance...
Let's do that to our heart's content right in the middle of the race.
